comment: Parameter 34, the sixth channel's Sum latch, is configured with the name 'Disabled' (src/EnvVCA6.cpp:362) and the summing loop runs over channels 1 to 5 only (src/EnvVCA6.cpp:518), so the button moves and lights but changes nothing; it is left untagged and covered by a Note instead of being given a line. Parameter 36, the gate output mode, has no ParamWidget at all and is reached only from the menu, so it gets no line either. Attack and release map as 10 raised to (knob - 0.5) * 6 seconds, floored at 1ms, which is 1ms to 1000 seconds (src/EnvVCA6.cpp:202-206). The envelope is fired by a rising edge and the level of the gate does not scale it. The summed envelope reaching channel 6 is a root-mean-square of the summed channels' envelopes and is combined with channel 6's own by taking the larger of the two (src/EnvVCA6.cpp:536-541). The panel prints the module name, a line crediting offthesky, and Manual, HOLD and Sum under each channel's three buttons; the jacks and the three knobs carry no lettering. Lettering is drawn in code at src/EnvVCA6.cpp:610-678.
